Exact candidates contain seven GLB files and 22 PNG files (9699328 RGBA bytes); sharing must plateau between N/4N. Capture candidate median p95 may add at most 2 ms and p99 at most 10 ms versus its adjacent same-source control; repeat MAD must stay within 10 percent. These are pre-release static increment limits only, not absolute gameplay, GPU allocation, ordinary lifecycle, art or release acceptance. Do not retune these limits after observing this campaign.
